items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah. And with Bobby it still is. We just finished a tour recently. We had the most fun ever.

ctx.x: Absolutely. Like I said, it’s a social tendency to want to interact with other musicians and set a game plan to play, and then learn from them, see what they bring to the table. Because like I say, it’s not like Mozart Piano Concerto where all the notes are written. It’s this song form, and a form that everyone improvises off of, which means that the musicians now bring a lot to it, and Avishai certainly brought a lot to it. Origin had a couple of his nice compositions in it, too.
You did several duos with Bobby McFerrin as well, which really exist unto themselves. Nothing I can think of sounds like those duos you did with him. Well, nothing he does sounds like anything else.
